newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus to sell 22.8 pct of Fandok timber company.
newsitem.headline: Belarus to sell 22.8 pct of Fandok timber company.

text.p: Belarus plans to sell 22.8 percent of shares in AO Fandok, one the country's biggest timber processing companies, a State Property Ministry official said on Thursday.
"The ministry is offering to investors 669,428 shares from state ownership worth 93.72 million Belarussian roubles," deputy department director Vladimir Mogilevets said.
He did not mention the date of the auction.

Fandok's authorised capital is 411 million Belarus roubles divided into 2.94 million shares. The face value of a share is 140,000 roubles. The state owns 76 percent of shares. The rest is owned by employees and individuals.
Mogilevets said the state had offered the 22.8 percent package of shares twice previously, but had not found any interested buyers.
"The ministry cannot cut the price as it was stipulated by the presidential decree," he said.
